name: Kon Pring village
summary: Spend about an hour in Kon Pring, a Mơ Nâm community village on Highway 24. The visit is the nhà rông, stilt houses, and gong culture. Mang Den Tourism prints 05:00–21:00 and marks the price as updating, so the fee is Check on arrival.
heroCaption: Kon Pring village, with a steep roof across the fields

notice.title: Ask before you photograph inside the nhà rông
notice.body: Go Vietnam Travel says to ask before photographs inside the communal house.

body: Kon Pring is one of four Kon Plông community tourism villages. You come for the nhà rông, the stilt houses, and the gong and xoang culture the rural tourism portal and Go Vietnam Travel describe. Weaving and rice wine are part of the same visit. The frame across the fields shows the village and a steep roof on the right.

Mang Den Tourism puts the village about 3 km from the center and prints hours of 05:00–21:00. Go Vietnam Travel and the Vietnam Tourism rural portal put it about 5 km from town. Use both distances and ask which road sign you are on. The same Mang Den Tourism line marks the price as updating. The fee is Check on arrival. Plan on the 60-minute minimum that line prints, then stay longer if a performance is on.

Gong and xoang are described as part of the visit, not as a fixed weekly clock. Ask that morning. Skip the village if Pa Sy and the lake already fill the day. An optional homestay is the overnight. It is not a ticket with a printed price. The evening back in town is a quiet meal, not a bar street.

figures.caption: A wooden house under pine at Kon Pring
figures.alt: A wooden house and fence under tall pine at Kon Pring village

gettingThere: The village is on Highway 24, a short ride from the Mang Den town strip. Mang Den Tourism prints about 3 km. Go Vietnam Travel and the Vietnam Tourism rural portal print about 5 km. Minutes are Check on arrival. Hire a car or ride a motorbike. Vietnam Tourism does not name a town bus.

legs.heading: From Mang Den town
legs.body: By car or motorbike on Highway 24. About 3 km on Mang Den Tourism, and about 5 km on Go Vietnam Travel and the Vietnam Tourism rural portal. The minutes are Check on arrival.

legs.heading: From Kon Tum city
legs.body: Go Vietnam Travel puts Kon Pring about 57 km from old Kon Tum city along Highway 24. Vietnam Tourism puts Mang Den about 60 km northeast of Kon Tum. The minutes and the fare are Check on arrival.

closed: No weekly closing day is printed. Check on arrival.
admissionNote: Mang Den Tourism marks the price as updating. The fee is Check on arrival. No child rule and no inclusion list are printed. A homestay meal is extra and has no printed price on Go Vietnam Travel or the rural tourism portal.
